title: Universal Backgammon Position v1 Candidate, cleanup revision 1.2.2
description: Engine-relevant semantic state only. The contract begins after the opening roll has resolved and an on-roll player is established. Source provenance, display view, and appearance are separate contracts.

phase.description: The unresolved opening-roll procedure is outside universal-position-v1. pre_roll starts only after an on-roll player has been established.

decision_type.description: The action choices currently available to decision_player. It is derived from phase, pending action, cube state, and rule context rather than supplied as an external rule.

enabled.description: true means cubeful play is positively established; false means cubeless or NoCube is positively established; null means the source did not establish whether the cube is enabled. A source may still encode nominal cube value and ownership while enabled remains unknown.

value.description: Current accepted cube value before any pending action. It is not the proposed value of a pending double, beaver, or raccoon.

owner.description: Current accepted cube ownership before any pending action.

offered_cube_value.description: The proposed accepted cube value. For double, beaver, and raccoon in v1, this must equal the current accepted cube.value multiplied by two.

resignation_multiplier.description: 1 for a single-game resignation, 2 for a gammon resignation, 3 for a backgammon resignation. Actual points equal cube.value times this multiplier.

rules.description: Analysis-semantic rule context. position-source-v1 records whether each value was decoded, supplied externally, or remains unknown.

automatic_doubles.description: Maximum automatic doubles permitted. Zero means disabled.

points.description: Length 24. Array index 0 is this player's point 1; array index 23 is this player's point 24.

off.description: Stored explicitly and validated against checker_count, points, and bar.

x-bms-invariants: For n in 1..24, player_0.points[n-1] and player_1.points[24-n] refer to the same physical point and cannot both be positive.
For each player, sum(points) + bar + off equals checker_count.
Known cube values and maximum cube values are powers of two.
The unresolved opening-roll procedure is outside v1. Every playing position has an established on_roll player.
Pre-roll doubling legality is three-valued: legal, illegal, or unknown. decision_type maps legal to roll_or_double, illegal to roll, and unknown to unknown.

A pre-roll double is legal only when cube.enabled is true, Crawford is false, cube ownership permits the on-roll player to double, and current and maximum cube values are both known with current value below maximum.
For pending double, beaver, or raccoon, offered_cube_value equals cube.value times two, decision_player equals responder, and offerer differs from responder.
For pending double and raccoon, on_roll equals offerer. For pending beaver, on_roll equals responder.
For pending double, cube.owner is center or offerer. For pending beaver, cube.owner is offerer. For pending raccoon, cube.owner is responder.
A pending double decision is take_drop_or_beaver only when beaver availability is positively established, take_or_drop when positively unavailable, and unknown otherwise.
A pending beaver decision is take_drop_or_raccoon only when raccoon availability is positively established, take_or_drop when positively unavailable, and unknown otherwise.
A pending raccoon decision is take_or_drop. Otters and later animal redoubles are outside v1.
game_state playing is required for pre_roll, checker_play, cube_response, beaver_response, raccoon_response, and resignation_response. game_state game_over is required for phase game_over.
